title.narrative: Supporting Climate Adaptation and Durable Solutions for Displacement Affected Communities (DACs) in the Shabelle River Basin, Networking with & Enhancing Efforts by Government & Administration in Afgoye District (NEGAAD)

description.narrative:
This is a durable solutions project, with early solutions components to address the 2022 food insecurity and displacement crisis, focusing on Afgoye district in South West State of Somalia. The outputs are:

Output 1.1: Through productive activities and social safety net programmes, vulnerable households increase their food security level

Output 1.2: Water access and environmental sanitation are improved through rapid, sustainable water provision, and hygiene promotion.

Output 1.3: Education services are scaled up to cater for increased numbers of IDPs.

Output 1.4: Vulnerable and remote DACs gain increased access to health and nutrition services in areas not covered by static health facilities
